standard-dialogue.player: Who is the true lord and king of the lands?

standard-dialogue.npc: The mighty heir and lord of the Wilderness.

standard-dialogue.player: Where is he? Why hasn't he lifted your burden?

standard-dialogue.npc: I have not fulfilled my purpose.
Not what is, what was. A great war tore this land apart and, for my failings in protecting this land, I carry the burden of its waste.
